name: orka
description: Search Orka context, manage project knowledge and reviews, install complete skills, and diagnose local synchronization.

interface.longDescription: Use the Orka account already signed in on this Mac. Approve the connector session in Orka to search shared context and history, save memories and plans, manage requests and permissions, install complete skills and inspect local sync within your access. The desktop app owns login and tool execution. Changing accounts or services requires a new connection. ENV content is excluded.
defaultPrompt: Find the shared context and skills relevant to my project.
Save this decision to Orka and update the project plan.
Check this project’s sync health and pending requests.
